delegate_child_linkage.identity_rule: permit_id, project_id, semantic_id, and authorization_request_digest must match the supported exact Delegate Permit.
delegate_child_linkage.creation_rule: The intended, created, and authority-grant delegate commitments must be byte-identical safe commitments.
delegate_child_linkage.acting_rule: A supported acting-child linkage additionally requires the acting commitment to match, an exact action-Permit binding digest, a non-empty authority-chain digest, exact request digest, and dispatch instant.
delegate_child_linkage.privacy_rule: Verifier-safe evidence contains commitments only. Clear child identifiers remain tenant-private or selectively disclosed with an audit reason.
delegate_child_linkage.claim_ceiling: The claim proves Keel-issued child linkage under the signed evidence and does not independently establish external identity or action correctness.
